name: CPX
summary: 8-Cyclopentyl-1,3-dipropylxanthine (DPCPX, PD-116,948) is a drug which acts as a potent and selective antagonist for the adenosine A1 receptor. It has high selectivity for A1 over other adenosine receptor subtypes, but as with other xanthine derivatives DPCPX also acts as a phosphodiesterase inhibitor, and is almost as potent as rolipram at inhibiting PDE4.

pharmacology.text: 8-Cyclopentyl-1,3-dipropylxanthine (DPCPX, PD-116,948) is a drug which acts as a potent and selective antagonist for the adenosine A1 receptor. It has high selectivity for A1 over other adenosine receptor subtypes, but as with other xanthine derivatives DPCPX also acts as a phosphodiesterase inhibitor, and is almost as potent as rolipram at inhibiting PDE4.

uses.text: It has been used to study the function of the adenosine A1 receptor in animals, which has been found to be involved in several important functions such as regulation of breathing and activity in various regions of the brain, and DPCPX has also been shown to produce behavioural effects such as increasing the hallucinogen-appropriate responding produced by the 5-HT2A agonist DOI, and the dopamine release induced by MDMA, as well as having interactions with a range of anticonvulsant drugs.

summaryZh: 8-環戊基-1,3-二丙基黃嘌呤是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C16H24N4O2，可作為腺苷A1受體的高效與選擇性的拮抗劑。

fact.en: It is a xanthine, like caffeine. Swapping caffeine's small methyl groups for larger propyl and cyclopentyl groups makes it far more selective for the A1 adenosine receptor.
fact.zh: 它和咖啡因一樣屬於黃嘌呤類。把咖啡因上的小甲基換成較大的丙基與環戊基，就讓它對 A1 腺苷受體的選擇性高得多。
fact.zhHans: 它和咖啡因一样属于黄嘌呤类。把咖啡因上的小甲基换成较大的丙基与环戊基，就让它对 A1 腺苷受体的选择性高得多。
